task: Bound exact numeric editing drafts before SwiftUI state accepts an oversized paste.

tests.scope: Isolated temporary Swift package linking the actual StudioNumericInput.swift and PrecisionDraftBoundTests.swift source files; Linux Swift 6.2.1.
Syntax parsing only; no Apple SDK or SwiftUI runtime validation.

details: A shared helper checks at most 257 UTF-8 bytes against the existing 256-byte raw-draft allowance, without traversing grapheme clusters.
The custom TextField binding rejects oversize replacements before assigning draft state; the preceding draft remains intact and no prefix is substituted.
A visible error and field accessibility hint explain the preserved entry. Apply remains blocked until an accepted bounded edit clears this error.
Empty, incomplete and localized drafts remain editable; exact initial formats, signed zero and all previous parser grammar/range tolerances are preserved.
Tests cover exact byte boundaries, multibyte decimal digits, a 100,000-combining-scalar paste, partial edits, exact initial formats and unchanged parser limits.
outcome.remainingValidation: Root to run the integrated full Swift suite; native iOS TextField and VoiceOver behavior were not exercised on this Linux host.
